title: Don't Train It, Write It: An AI Agent Writes New Capabilities into Language Model Weights
abstract: arXiv:2611.28483v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We show that an AI agent can write new capabilities into a pretrained language model by adding gated attention heads and MLP neurons inside its existing layers, without backpropagation and without fitting any weight to the answers of task examples. It has a budget of 50 model passes and sees no validation or test instance. Composed in one model, its modules for six BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) subtasks raise the normalized BBH score of Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct from 19.95 to 41.05 (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: at most 35.01) and that of Gemma-3-1B-it from 10.25 to 32.86. Against the unmodified model at the same precision, both composites leave the next-token distribution on 1,023,000 WikiText tokens unchanged (KL exactly 0), give identical answers on 15,845 items of five other Leaderboard tests and identical scores on the other 18 BBH subtasks. translated_title: 无需训练，直接编写：AI智能体将新能力写入语言模型权重
translated_abstract: 我们证明，AI智能体可以通过在预训练语言模型的现有层内部添加带门控的注意力头和MLP神经元，将新能力写入模型，而无需反向传播，也无需根据任务示例的答案拟合任何权重。它仅有50次模型前向传递的预算，且不接触任何验证或测试实例。将针对六个BIG-Bench Hard（BBH）子任务的模块组合进同一模型后，Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct的归一化BBH分数从19.95提升至41.05（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct最高为35.01），Gemma-3-1B-it的分数从10.25提升至32.86。在与未修改模型相同的精度下，两个组合模型在1,023,000个WikiText词元上的下一个词元分布完全不变（KL散度精确为0），在五个其他排行榜测试的15,845个题目上给出相同答案，并在其他18个BBH子任务上获得相同分数。该智能体还实现了精确的20位数乘法，而模型仅需运行最多6次（在未见过的...上达到100.0%——摘要至此截断）
tldr: 一个AI智能体通过在现有层中添加门控注意力头和MLP神经元，在完全不进行反向传播或权重训练的情况下，将新能力直接写入语言模型权重，使小模型在六个BBH子任务上的性能大幅超越更大的7B模型，同时严格保持模型原有行为零改变。
en_tdlr: An AI agent writes new capabilities directly into language model weights by adding gated attention heads and MLP neurons—without backpropagation or any training—boosting small models past a 7B model on six BBH subtasks while leaving the model's original behavior completely unchanged.
